name: Winrate Tracker
description: Winrate tracking using a EMA algorithm

title-enable.name: Enable Labels
title-enable.description: These settings control which labels are displayed

keybind-reset-and-record.name: Reset and record run
keybind-reset-and-record.description: This keybind allows you to reset while still keeping the increased winrate from passing parts in your run. Used to practice a part over and over without having to die or complete the level. Does not increase attempt count.

title-labels.name: Text Settings
title-labels.description: Settings controlling the visuals of the labels

label-opacity.name: Label Opacity
label-opacity.description: Changes the opacity of the labels

label-size.name: Label Size
label-size.description: Changes the size of the labels

title-format.name: Formatting Settings
title-format.description: These settings control formatting for the text labels

title-advanced.name: Advanced Settings
title-advanced.description: These settings change the behaviour of winrate tracking

settings-alpha.name: Alpha value
settings-alpha.description: Alpha determines how fast your winrate changes. A lower alpha results in a slower but more stable rate. A higher Alpha results in faster changes but is less stable. I would not recommend going much higher than the default 0.15 but you could potentially decrease it if you are playing levels longterm.

settings-safezone.name: Safezone Duration (seconds)
settings-safezone.description: Changes the duration of the safezone. The safezone is activated whenever you play from a startpos or checkpoint and prevents winrate changes within the safezone. The point is that when respawning to a startposition, you will often die in ways you don't from 0.

settings-platformer.name: Enable on Platformer Mode
settings-platformer.description: Enables the mod for platformer. The mod isn't meant for that, but it could potentially be used on autoscroll levels with no checkpoint.
